status_label: BNPB preliminary impact update at 18:48 WIB — verification and reconciliation continue

source.title: Update — Impact of the M7.7 NTT earthquake: more than 40 deaths

casualties.source_note: Deaths are from BNPB at 18:48 WIB. Injury totals and severity are from the Ministry of Health report dated 15 August, which does not state a specific cut-off time.

Nagekeo Regency.note: Nagekeo was not listed in the BNPB death distribution at the 18:48 WIB cut-off.

East Flores Regency.note: No casualty report was available in the Ministry of Health table; East Flores was not listed in the BNPB death distribution.

displacement.note: The latest Ministry of Health report lists the evacuee count as still under assessment; the earlier BNPB estimate is retained only as historical context.

damage.snapshot_status: BNPB preliminary damage update at 17:00 WIB on 15 August 2026.

confirmed: BNPB recorded 47 deaths at the 18:48 WIB cut-off: 24 in Manggarai, 17 in East Manggarai, 3 in Sikka and 1 each in West Manggarai, Ngada and Ende.
The Ministry of Health report dated 15 August recorded 46 deaths and 113 injured people: 36 seriously injured and 77 with minor injuries; its specific cut-off time was not stated.
The source difference of one death is preserved and not reconciled by assumption.
The Ministry of Health listed 2,196,745 people across eight affected regencies; this is a population-in-affected-areas figure, not a confirmed count of individually affected people.
The evacuee count remains under assessment in the Ministry of Health report.
damage_reports: BNPB's 17:00 WIB snapshot recorded 157 houses heavily damaged, 41 moderately damaged and 148 slightly damaged.
BNPB reported 87 education facilities, 18 health facilities, 5 places of worship and 6 offices affected at the 17:00 WIB damage cut-off.

The Ministry of Health separately reported structural damage at 9 hospitals and 68 puskesmas. This 77-facility health-sector count is retained separately because definitions and cut-offs may differ from BNPB's 18 affected health facilities.

BNPB reported that 50,000 assistance packages weighing 275 tonnes were being mobilised; 10,500 packages had arrived at the Halim base of operations. These are staging figures, not confirmed delivery to affected communities.
Transport, road, electricity and telecommunications disruptions continue to be assessed by the responsible agencies.
information_gaps: Verified evacuee totals and evacuation-site distribution by district.
Reconciled casualty records across BNPB, the Ministry of Health, BPBD, Basarnas and district authorities.
Reconciled definitions and facility-level lists for BNPB's 18 affected health facilities versus the Ministry of Health's 77 facilities with structural damage.
Verified service-restoration status for WASH, electricity, roads, transport and telecommunications.
Post-disaster disease-surveillance, animal-health and official monetary damage-and-loss estimates.
disclaimer: BNPB's 18:48 WIB update is used for the consolidated death headline and its 17:00 WIB update for general damage. Ministry of Health figures are retained for injuries and detailed health-sector status, with the source's unstated cut-off shown explicitly. All figures remain preliminary and subject to reconciliation.
